card.line: Mount Tabor is a lone, rounded mountain in northern Israel, where Barak gathered Israel's army before a great victory over Sisera, and a place the Bible uses to praise God.

moments.title: Barak Goes to Tabor
moments.text: Deborah tells Barak that the LORD commands him to march to Mount Tabor with ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun. The LORD promises to hand Sisera over to him.

moments.title: Victory Over Sisera
moments.text: When Sisera hears that Barak has gone up Mount Tabor, he gathers his chariots. Deborah tells Barak the day has come, and he goes down with ten thousand men. The LORD routs Sisera's whole army.

moments.title: Gideon Asks About Tabor
moments.text: Gideon asks Zebah and Zalmunna about the men they killed at Tabor. They were his brothers, so Gideon kills the two kings.

moments.title: The Oak of Tabor
moments.text: Samuel tells Saul he will come to the Oak of Tabor. Three men going up to Bethel will meet him there and give him two loaves of bread.

moments.title: Tabor Shouts for Joy
moments.text: The psalmist says God created north and south. Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at His name.
